content_sections.heading: Madras University Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Madras University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Madras University Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate: Postgraduate in a social science discipline or a relevant field (minimum 55%) with NET/ M. Phil./ Ph.D. and two years of experience or published at least two research papers. Research Assistant: Postgraduate in Social Science discipline or a relevant field (minimum 55%). Field Investigator: Postgraduate in Social Science discipline or a relevant field (minimum 55%).

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Madras University Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 31 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts announced by Madras University?
faq.answer: Madras University has announced vacancies for the posts of Research Associate, Research Assistant, and Field Investigator. There are a total of 5 vacancies available across these positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for all posts is a Postgraduate degree in a social science discipline or a relevant field with a minimum of 55% marks. Additional qualifications like NET/M.Phil./Ph.D. are required for the Research Associate position.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Research Associate and Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate post is 45 years, and for the Research Assistant post, it is 40 years. The age limit for Field Investigator posts is not specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 47,000/-. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There are three vacancies available for the Field Investigator post. Each Field Investigator position offers a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), ID proof, and category certificates (if applicable), along with recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for Madras University Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Madras University, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 600005. Candidates should report to the specified venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these contractual posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an interview. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted and called for an interview.
